author: MontanaCreedmoor
notes_extra: He wrote straight 284 Win and H4381sc. 32 in Krieger. 0.15 in group at 100 yards. The 53.6 gr row for the 180 Hybrid in the same post is not this bullet.

author: MontanaCreedmoor
notes_extra: 32 in barrel. 0.164 in group. Jumps from 10 to 40 thousandths. He wrote CCI2 BR2.

author: MontanaCreedmoor
notes_extra: Same 53.4 gr recipe as his Jul 23 test, chronoed at 300 yards. 0.24 MOA, 0.762 in, 5-shot groups.

author: MontanaCreedmoor
notes_extra: 0.37 MOA at 1,000 yards, 5 thousandths jump. No charge. He also said H4350 grouped 0.40 MOA and gave no charge or velocity for that powder.

author: Blacktornado
notes_extra: He wrote 57,8. 0.185 MOA at 400 meters. About 20 thou jump. The 180 VLD and 180 Hybrid charges in the same post are other bullets.

author: thomasholbrook43
notes_extra: 15 jump. He wrote Pappier and Stealb at 640 yards. On Aug 20 he answered the cartridge question with 7mm RSAUM and said he slowed them to 2950 fps as the final load, without giving that charge.

author: coford
notes_extra: 0.005 off shot best, 0.030 off second. 0.220 freebore. No pressure signs. He did not name the cartridge; this thread is the .284 184 Hybrid discussion.

author: rardoin
notes_extra: He wrote straight .284. About 0.015 off light touch. Unturned Norma. 30 in Bartlein. The H4350 match load was a plan, not a result.

author: Chubbles
notes_extra: New Lapua 6.5-284 brass necked up. 32 in Bartlein. Avg velocity 2820 fps at 80 F. Lands or under 0.010 jump. Later stabilized near 2820 after about 250 rounds, up about 35 fps.

author: F Class John
notes_extra: Seated -0.021. No powder and no charge. He did not name the cartridge; the thread is the .284.

author: SS GO DEVIL
notes_extra: 0.005 jam. 30 in Krieger. 1.7 in 5-shot group at 600 yards. No velocity.

author: Ackley Kid
notes_extra: He said 2790-2830 works depending on barrel length, and that he is running 2790 fps with H4350. 30 in Bartlein 1-8.5. He did not name the cartridge; the thread is the .284. RL 23 had limited testing and no charge.

author: etienne
notes_extra: He wrote 58,6gr. 29 in 1:8. Seating from 0.020 to 0.005 was mediocre. Freebore 0.230. He did not say which primer he used.

author: etienne
notes_extra: Same rifle. Pierced primers when the temperature rose 50 F. Two of three hits at a mile.

author: TZaun
notes_extra: 8.5 twist. No charge. He did not repeat the cartridge; the thread is 7 SAUM 184 gr.

author: rebel107
notes_extra: 1-8 twist. Jumped 10 thou. Six shots, SD 3.5. No charge.

author: Cody Richardson
notes_extra: Moderate load, no grain weight. 26 in barrel he spelled Bartelin, 1-9 twist. The 180/184 class H4831sc speed in the same post is not stored as a 184-only charge.

author: DanielMaple
notes_extra: He wrote n566. 5-shot 0.5 in. SD 5.2, ES 13. Same COAL 2.960.

author: DanielMaple
notes_extra: He wrote 5 shit. 0.5 in group. SD 9, ES 19. Same COAL 2.960.

author: DanielMaple
notes_extra: One shot. He wrote COAL 2,9640, which is not stored as a length. 22 in Proof 1:8. ADG brass.

author: DanielMaple
notes_extra: Three shots. 1 in group, clickers, heavy bolt, extractor marks. He did not go higher.

author: DanielMaple
notes_extra: 41 degrees. Light clicker at 62.5. Extractor mark at 62.75.

author: DanielMaple
notes_extra: 45 degrees. Light clicker at 62.77, moderate clicker at 63. A loose brake affected the groups.

author: DanielMaple
notes_extra: The load he went with. 20-shot average 2728 fps, SD 4.8, ES 13, at 385 yards. The fetched page did not show a separate date.

author: Fire Dog
notes_extra: No pressure. On Dec 1, 2023 he said the same 55.7 gr was giving good results in a 30 in 1:8.5 Swan and a 32 in Blake.

author: Fire Dog
notes_extra: He wrote 2'830fps and 4831sc {Ar2213sc}.

author: Fire Dog
notes_extra: 30 thou jump. He did not repeat the cartridge in this sentence; the thread is 280 AI.

author: Willow
notes_extra: Two different loads at 2830 and 2900 fps. No charges. About 40 thou jump. 32 in 1:8.5.

author: Willow
notes_extra: Mild load, no pressure, easy on brass. Around 2810 fps. 32 in barrel. He said he used to run this.

author: Willow
notes_extra: Same post. 52 gr H4350 around the same velocity as the 55 gr RL23 row, with 184s. He had better accuracy with H4350 than with H4831sc, and gave no H4831sc charge.
